question: How much does an overnight stay cost?
answer: Overnight packages start at ₱3,500 for the Teepee Huts (good for 4 pax) and go up to ₱12,000 for the Exclusive accommodation (good for 15 pax). Rates include use of common grounds and basic amenities. Check the Rates section on this page for the full breakdown per accommodation.
answer_tl: Ang overnight package ay nagsisimula sa ₱3,500 para sa Teepee Huts (pang-4 pax) hanggang ₱12,000 para sa Exclusive (pang-15 pax). Kasama na sa rate ang paggamit ng common grounds at basic amenities. Tingnan ang Rates section sa page na ito para sa buong listahan.

question: How much is a day tour?
answer: We no longer offer day tour packages — Camp Enoki is overnight stays only for now. Check out our overnight rates below!
answer_tl: Wala na po kaming day tour package — overnight stay na lang po ang alok ng Camp Enoki sa ngayon. Tingnan na lang ang aming overnight rates sa baba!

question: Is a specific date available?
answer: You can check availability and book directly on our official booking site — tap the button below.
answer_tl: Pwede niyong tingnan ang availability at direktang mag-book sa aming official booking site — pindutin ang button sa baba.

question: Where is Camp Enoki located and how do we get there?
answer: Camp Enoki is nestled by the river with easy access from the highway. Tap the button below to open directions in Google Maps.
answer_tl: Ang Camp Enoki ay nasa tabing-ilog, madaling puntahan mula sa highway. Pindutin ang button sa baba para sa directions sa Google Maps.

question: What amenities are included?
answer: Camp Enoki offers a swimming pool, riverside deck, common cooking area with gas stove, comfort rooms with hot and cold shower, free parking, and a bonfire pit. See the Amenities section for the full list.
answer_tl: May swimming pool, riverside deck, common cooking area na may gas stove, CR na may hot at cold shower, libreng parking, at bonfire pit. Tingnan ang Amenities section para sa buong listahan.

question: Can I see the teepee huts?
answer: Here are our teepee huts — cozy tent-style accommodations good for small groups, each with fan, sleeping mats, and a private outdoor seating area.
answer_tl: Eto ang aming teepee huts — cozy tent-style na tirahan na bagay sa maliit na grupo, may fan, sleeping mats, at sariling outdoor seating area.

question: Show me the beach / river area.
answer: Our riverside area has a shallow swimming spot great for kids, plus a sandy stretch perfect for lounging and photos.
answer_tl: Ang riverside area namin ay may mababaw na swimming spot na bagay sa mga bata, at may buhanginan din na maganda para sa relax at picture-picture.

question: How do I make a booking?
answer: Tap the "Book Now" button below — it'll take you to our official booking site where you can pick your dates and submit your request directly.
answer_tl: Pindutin ang "Book Now" button sa baba — dadalhin kayo sa aming official booking site kung saan pwede kayong pumili ng dates at direktang mag-submit ng request.

question: Are pets allowed?
answer: Yes, well-behaved pets are welcome! Please keep them leashed in common areas and clean up after them. Let us know in your booking so we can prepare accordingly.
answer_tl: Oo, pwede magdala ng maayos na alagang hayop! Paki-leash lang sa common areas at linisin agad kung may dumi. Isama na lang sa booking form para mapaghandaan namin.

question: What time is check-in and check-out?
answer: Check-in is at 2:00 PM and check-out is at 12:00 NN.
answer_tl: Ang check-in ay 2:00 PM at ang check-out ay 12:00 NN.

question: What is your cancellation policy?
answer: Bookings are confirmed only once the downpayment is received, and ALL downpayments are non-refundable — cancellations for any reason forfeit the downpayment, and no-shows forfeit all payments made. You may rebook once, free of a new downpayment, if you ask at least 7 days before your check-in date; the new date must be used within 6 months and any price difference is on the guest. Camp Enoki is a pool resort and stays open in the rain, so weather isn't a valid reason for a cancellation, refund, or rebooking, and there are no refunds for early check-out either.
answer_tl: Ang booking ay kina-confirm lang pagka-receive ng downpayment, at LAHAT ng downpayment ay hindi na po nire-refund — ang pag-cancel sa kahit anong dahilan ay mawawala ang downpayment, at ang no-show ay mawawala lahat ng bayad. Pwede kayong mag-rebook ng isang beses, kung sasabihin niyo at least 7 araw bago ang check-in; gagamitin within 6 months at ang price difference ay sagot ng guest. Bukas kami kahit umuulan (pool resort kami), kaya hindi valid ang panahon bilang dahilan para mag-cancel, mag-refund, o mag-rebook, at wala ring refund kung maaga ang check-out.

question: How do we pay?
answer: We accept GCash (0947 998 4309) and bank transfer. Your booking is confirmed only once we receive the downpayment, with the balance payable upon arrival. Please note all downpayments are non-refundable.
answer_tl: Tumatanggap kami ng GCash (0947 998 4309) at bank transfer. Kina-confirm lang ang booking pagka-receive ng downpayment, at babayaran na lang ang balance pag-dating. Paalala: hindi na po nire-refund ang downpayment.

question: What attractions are nearby?
answer: Camp Enoki is close to several waterfalls, viewpoints, and local eateries. See the Nearby Attractions section for details and distances.
answer_tl: Malapit ang Camp Enoki sa ilang waterfalls, viewpoints, at local eateries. Tingnan ang Nearby Attractions section para sa detalye at distansya.

question: How can I contact the staff directly?
answer: You can reach our staff through the contact details on this page, or leave your question here and we'll follow up with you directly.
answer_tl: Pwede niyo kaming kontakin gamit ang contact details sa page na ito, o pwede rin niyong itanong dito at fofollow-up namin kayo.

question: Is there WiFi?
answer: We're a nature getaway, so WiFi is limited to the common area only — a great excuse to unplug! Mobile signal is generally available on-site.
answer_tl: Nature getaway kami, kaya limitado lang ang WiFi sa common area — magandang dahilan para mag-unplug! May mobile signal naman sa site.

question: What activities or add-ons do you offer?
answer: We offer add-ons like karaoke, ATV, kayak, jetski, and banana boat rides (rates and availability at the resort). Tap below for more photos of past guest activities.
answer_tl: May mga add-ons kami tulad ng karaoke, ATV, kayak, jetski, at banana boat (rates at availability sa resort mismo). Pindutin sa baba para sa mas maraming photos ng activities.

question: Is there a fee for extra guests?
answer: Each package includes a set number of pax. Additional guests beyond the package limit are ₱150 per head.
answer_tl: Kasama sa bawat package ang isang set na bilang ng pax. Ang sobrang guest ay ₱150 kada tao.
